manifest.description: Per-platform understeer-gradient correction over the V0 KS baseline: yhat = a*shift(yp,k)/(1+K*v^2) + b. Coefficients live in coeffs.json. Tesla passes V0 through unchanged (truth = V0 on this platform).

TESLA_MODEL_3.note: Tesla sim truth column IS the V0 KS output (psi_dot_rads). V0 passthrough is optimal.
